notes:
According to U.S. Dept. of Labor documents, Gustav arrived in the USA on March 19,1936 at New York, on the SS New Rochelle.

On his "Common Plea" dated Apr. 27, 1936 he states he was not married, had no children, and former place of residence was Rinnersdorf, Germany. He sailed from Bremen, Germany. After arrival he married Betty Jane Streeby which lasted about 6 mos. and they were divorced in Summit County (see doc) Nov. 2, 1945. He then married Gretchen Fricke (she was a war bride) on Jan. 28, 1948 in Canton, OH.

In "Reminiscences of Gustave Zelmer" it says, quote: "I served in the American army for three years in Europe during World War II. I was a medic and did not carry a gun. We landed on Utah Beach in France.  At Bastonge the German army broke through and our division was cut off for several weeks. I drove an ambulance with a broken spring from Ottam, Germany, to Liege, Belgium, one night over rough, open country."
